title: Help option
description: The sources define no --help option. Usage errors exit 2 with a usage line on standard error that names both command forms.

options.label: No --help; usage line on error only

system_choice: no-help

title: Blank lines and invalid UTF-8
description: encoding/csv skips blank lines, which is taken as the narrowest meaning of record. Invalid UTF-8 is not a rejection condition because the rejection list is exhaustive.

options.label: Skip blank lines; accept invalid UTF-8

system_choice: csv-default

title: Directory as input path
description: A path naming a directory cannot be read as a file, so it is an operational failure.
system_choice: exit-1
